issues.on_page: General Government: General 14,527 + Street 10,368; Public Safety - Police & Fire: General 1,924 + Street 1,924
issues.issue: Recorded as printed, but the Street Fund's whole 12,292 of spending is printed under General Government and Police & Fire (nothing on line 32 Public Works - Streets), and the Police & Fire amount is the same in both funds. The village probably put its street spending on the wrong lines. As a result streets/highways shows 0 even though the village received 25,169 of highway allocation. Someone should review this.
